source: PLACEHOLDER: textbook values. Replace with the coach's own clips using build_reference.py.

elbow_at_contact.low: Extend your arm fully into the smash. Your elbow is about {diff}° more bent than the coach's, which takes away power and steepness.
elbow_at_contact.high: Your arm locks fully straight at contact. Keep a slight bend so the forearm can rotate through the shot.

shoulder_at_contact.low: Reach higher. Your elbow is about {diff}° lower than the coach's at contact, so you hit the shuttle too flat.
shoulder_at_contact.high: You are hitting too far behind your head for a smash. Meet the shuttle further in front so it travels down.

elbow_at_prep.low: Your racket arm folds very tightly when you prepare. Relax the elbow slightly so the swing stays smooth.
elbow_at_prep.high: Load the racket more. Bend your elbow and bring the racket behind your head before swinging; you are {diff}° straighter than the coach.

trunk_lean_at_contact.low: You are leaning forward at contact. Stay tall and let your body rotate instead.
trunk_lean_at_contact.high: You are leaning back about {diff}° more than the coach. Get behind the shuttle earlier with your footwork.

knee_bend_at_prep.low: You are crouching deeply while preparing. A slight knee bend is enough.
knee_bend_at_prep.high: Bend your back knee a little as you prepare so you can push up into the shot.

contact_height.low: Hit the shuttle at the highest point you can reach. Your contact point is lower than the coach's.
contact_height.high: Good height. You can afford to let the shuttle drop a fraction so you can hit through it.

prep_to_contact_s.low: Your swing is very short. Start the swing from a fuller loaded position.
prep_to_contact_s.high: Your swing is slow, about {diff} s longer than the coach's. Prepare early, then swing in one quick motion.
